variant.title: German Whispers Sudoku
variant.description: Every adjacent pair on a whisper line differs by at least five.
rule.german_whispers: Adjacent digits on a whisper line must differ by at least 5.
rule_guide.title: German Whispers Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Digits on a whisper line are orthogonally connected.
rule_guide.item_2: Every adjacent pair on the line differs by at least five.
rule_guide.item_3: A whisper line may turn at an orthogonal corner.
